subject: All She Wrote Books Holiday Operations
overview: Anna Callahan interviewed Christina Pascucci Ciampa about the mission and history of All She Wrote Books in Somerville. The discussion focused on the bookstore's transition to a brick-and-mortar location during the COVID-19 pandemic and its available holiday services.

items.title: Bookstore mission and history
items.summary: Christina Pascucci Ciampa described All She Wrote Books as an intersectional queer feminist bookstore dedicated to uplifting marginalized voices through curated titles and safe community space.

items.title: Impact of COVID-19 on opening
items.summary: Pascucci Ciampa discussed signing a lease in February 2020 and adapting the business model to include online sales, contactless pickup, and private browsing appointments following state-mandated closures.

items.title: Holiday shopping and store operations
items.summary: The owner outlined holiday shipping deadlines, curbside pickup procedures, and current operating hours for the remainder of the 2020 season.
